headline.W27-P1: At N=8 the only mixed profile above off-count 4 is (3,3,2) => X_5 = EXACT at N=8; X_4 is the penultimate rung; X_4 empty => Krenn-Gu at N=8.
headline.W27-D2: (3,3,2) has two odd parts => on the monochrome-diagonal stratum X_4 = X_5 = EXACT at N=8. A diagonal X_4 point at N=8 WOULD BE an exact source.
headline.W27-D3: No-cancellation diagonal stratum at N=8 is EMPTY: exhaustive over 32970 disjoint PM triples of K_8; (C) passes 16800, (D) passes 8610, both 0.
headline.W27-R1: X_k(N) nonempty <=> some K_{N-1} background makes all three colour systems at a site consistent; consistency <=> r_const not in rowspan(mixed rows); needs rank(mixed) <= 3(N-1)-1.
headline.W27-R2: sigma/rho-symmetric backgrounds make the three colour systems equivalent: one feasible colour system would suffice.
headline.W27-S1: N=6 diagonal skeleton law: WITNESS <=> some endpoint c1-simple (deg_c1=1) OR both endpoints almost-clean (deg_c1=2, other two degrees 1). Exact on 279/279 pairs, 24/24 classes.
headline.W27-S2: W27-S1 fails at N=8: 63 of 377 exactly-decided pairs wrong; 12 of 63 endpoint-type cells mixed; no global feature separates either.
headline.W27-S3: But the witness set IS still constant across weight points at N=8 (6 skeletons x 4 points) -- a skeleton law exists at N=8 and is non-local.
headline.W27-C1: Calibration: probe fires 40/40 (6,3) and 25/25 (8,3) on Delta^3 backgrounds (known-nonempty rungs), 0 at (6,4)=EXACT and 0 at (8,4); (8,4) has the (6,4) signature.

x4_n8_verdict.obstruction: For Delta^3_8 backgrounds the infeasibility certificate has SIZE 1: a single off-count-4 word whose site-z row is proportional to the constant word's row (RHS 0 vs 1). It is exactly the (4,4,0)/(4,2,2) failure of W27-D3.
x4_n8_verdict.label: CONJECTURED: X_4 = empty at N=8 (would prove Krenn-Gu at N=8)
